notes.title: Weekend sale 60% OFF for the East Tower series.
notes.content:
All games within the East Tower series, visual novel otome games with gender bender element are now 60% OFF and the complication bundle itself is 70% OFF.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2134/East_Tower_Complete_Edition/

The games are unique and full with gender-bender comedy, with a mystery touch which connects all the four games. Don't forget to play at least one of the three games before the last East Tower- Kurenai to understand the story better.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/bundles/2134/nsllh2jxuy8ppcn5/header_586x192.jpg?t=1516023086[/img]

Enjoy! :tako::takashi:

notes.title: Steam Cloud Support
notes.content:
The game now supports Steam Cloud.
You can load the save data you saved on a different computer with a same OS only (Windows save data can be loaded only on Windows computer, and Mac save data can be loaded only on Mac computer.)

If you don't see the sync, please check your steam installation folder, go find userdata folder>[somenumber]>7/remote/sharedconfig.vdf and be sure to change cloudenabled to 1

notes.title: East Tower - Kurenai is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
The last game of the East Tower series, "East Tower - Kurenai" is now available on Steam!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/356560

It has 41 achievements, trading cards, over 100 event CGs (with variations) and estimated about 6-10 hours play time.

notes.title: Change Ratings to R-15
notes.content:
I decided to change East Tower - Akio and the whole games within East Tower series to R-15. East Tower - Akio, Takashi, and Kuon might be PG-13, but Kurenai is definitely R-15 in my opinion.
Therefore I decide to make them all the same.

Thank you and I hope for your understanding.

notes.title: Steam Keys for previous purchasers.
notes.content:
You can redeem the Steam Keys if you have bought the game before. 
*This only applied for people who bought the Win/Mac, not the mobile ones. 

[h1]For Bundles' Purchasers[/h1]
Please contact Indie Royale or Groupees since I've sent the keys to both parties. 

[h1]For People Who Bought The Hardcopies or Bought Through Official Site[/h1]
Please fill in the form on the link below and I'll send you the keys later. 
[url=http://www.roseverte.net/steam.html]CLICK HERE[/url]

[h1]For People Who Bought Through Desura[/h1]
For people who bought on Desura directly, not from any bundles, please PM me on Desura.

I don't accept any questions or claims about the bundle provider's services. I will only help you to ask them if they're quite late in uploading the keys.

Thank you.
